# Noto Sans Mono

Monospace font for numbers, logs, and identifiers in Virtual Vessel Studio (docs/en/ui/design-system.md, chapter 4).

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Files | `NotoSansMono-Regular.ttf` (weight 400) |
| Source | Google Fonts, static instance served by fonts.gstatic.com (`notosansmono/v37`) |
| Upstream | https://github.com/notofonts/latin-greek-cyrillic |
| License | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`) |

The file is not modified. Distributions include `OFL.txt`.
